findings.text: Reservation entry validates requested text capacity, briefly suppresses interrupts, obtains a descriptor identifier, clears per-record metadata while deriving the next sequence value, finalizes the predecessor, obtains text storage, and on text shortage finalizes a storageless record and reports failure while clearing the caller record; success records the storage footprint.

Observed record collaboration uses a reservation handle carrying ring reference, descriptor identifier, saved interrupt state and accounted text footprint, plus a caller record carrying metadata pointer, text pointer and requested size; write preparation initializes metadata and text pointers to empty while retaining requested size.

Sequence assignment treats zero on a non-initial slot as unset and uses slot position, otherwise adds full descriptor capacity to the prior value; any positive sequence causes the immediately preceding identifier to be moved toward reader visibility before new text is claimed.

Descriptor identifiers advance past a tail that is pushed forward when the ring is full; tail pushing rejects busy reserved or committed states, converts finalized to reusable, accepts reusable, treats a missing identifier one wrap behind head as busy and a changed identifier as already advanced, invalidates associated data before tail movement, and only advances when the successor is finalized or reusable or another agent already moved the tail.

Descriptor allocation is lock-free using head progression with conditional update, tail sampling, and paired read, write and full ordering between reserve, tail push, reuse, finalize and read paths; reservation failure increments a shared failure counter and unexpected recycled state or transition contention triggers an external diagnostic path.
Final commit entry moves a prior reservation to the finalized state and then refreshes the cached last-finalized marker for the ring.

Logging wakeup entries request waiter notification with optional output demand; the shared helper returns early when per-CPU state is not ready or console work is blocked, otherwise suppresses preemption, checks for sleepers or output demand with ordering against waiter preparation, sets per-CPU pending flags and queues processor-local work.

Printk reservation holds interrupts disabled across the descriptor reserve and commit window to reduce full-ring blocking, restoring them on failure or in commit; logging wakeup holds preemption disabled while checking sleepers and queueing processor-local work.

Warning helpers guard execution with a context-tracking region, honor a test-suppression check, emit a separator marker, then either forward file, line, caller address, taint and optional formatted arguments to a central warning path or directly emit a formatted message, always releasing the guard.
Warning-once reset entry clears generic once state and zeroes the dedicated once range, exposed during early initialization as a write-only diagnostic file; creation failure is ignored.

Stack guard failure path is visible and non-instrumented, opens an instrumentation region, preserves user-access state, reports corruption with caller address through a fatal path, and does not return normally.

Panic-related parameter handlers delegate panic-print access to unsigned-long helpers with a deprecation step, accept a boot option selecting panic on exception, and parse a taint mask as hexadecimal with an optional trailing token enabling user-taint exclusion, masking to allowed flags, rejecting missing or zero masks, and logging the resulting configuration.

Automatic sleep work samples a wakeup count, acquires a dedicated mutex, revalidates the count and running state, ignores the on state, selects hibernation for large states and suspend otherwise, releases the mutex, resamples the count and pauses briefly when no accountable wakeup occurred, then re-arms; re-arming queues work only when the configured state is above on.

Automatic sleep serializes state inspection and sleep entry with a dedicated mutex held across validation and the suspend or hibernate call; console-switch eligibility serializes list inspection with a dedicated mutex held across emptiness, enablement and requirement checks.

Hibernation entry checks availability and compressor support, takes system sleep protection and an exclusive guard, prepares the console, runs robust and ordinary notifications around filesystem synchronization and freezing, freezes tasks, pauses hotplug, builds memory bitmaps, captures a snapshot, writes the image with platform, compression and checksum mode flags or handles restore, powers down unless testing resume, then unwinds bitmaps, hotplug, test-image verification, task thaw, filesystem thaw, notifications, console restore and guard release.

Console power helpers move to a suspend console and redirect kernel messages while preserving originals when switching is permitted, and later restore the original console and redirection; switching is permitted when the switch list is empty, when console suspension is disabled, or when any entry demands it, otherwise it is denied.

Hibernation exclusivity uses a counter decremented only when non-zero with increment on release; availability requires hibernation not disabled plus absence of lockdown restriction, active protected memory, and active special memory.

Snapshot creation clears suspend flags, opens platform handling, prepares devices for freeze, preallocates image storage, freezes kernel threads, honors a freezer self-test with early thaw, suspends consoles, restricts allocation, suspends devices, recovers platform on error or device-test demand else creates the image, releases preallocation on error or restore path, resumes devices with recovery, thaw or restore semantics, restores allocation, resumes consoles, completes devices and closes platform.
Platform hooks are inert unless platform mode is requested and operations are registered, with recovery additionally requiring a registered recovery callback.

Debug test selection reports active only when the configured level equals the queried level after a configured delay in seconds, while an alternate build configuration reports inactive for every level.
